factual_claims.claim: TKM Grupp AS reported a weaker financial performance in 2025 amid a challenging Estonian economic environment, low consumer confidence, intense retail competition and the introduction of Estonia’s motor vehicle tax.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
